# Size budget, in bytes, of the release `erk` binary built on Linux
# (x86_64, ubuntu-latest) with the default release profile. Checked by the
# `size` CI job (.github/scripts/check-size-budget.sh).
#
# The budget comes from a measurement, not a target: M1.0 measured the
# binary and set the budget 10% above it. Lowering it is always allowed;
# raising it needs a reason on the budget's line:
#   <bytes>  # raised: <reason>
34213414  # raised: the GPU path (wgpu, naga, vello_hybrid) in the shell, M2.5: 31103104 bytes on ubuntu-latest (PR #35); the budget is 110% of it
